offers.description: Welcome! Your service is invaluable to us! We need your help. The Radar Display found at Lush Fields in the area of Harry's, at 2999.4, 3293.0, has been disabled by opposing troops... mutant riff-raff or whatever... I need not stress the tactical importance of Radar Displays, do I? Anyway, after a thorough search, we have found that the Super-Coolant component needs replacement after you have secured the area. Your mission objective would then be to install the Super-Coolant correctly in the Radar Display, and get out within 48 hours. Reward: 2025 XP and 1160 credits. Ok, that is all for now. Good luck.
